name: features-grid
description: Responsive grid of feature cards — icon + title + description. 3-column on desktop, single column on mobile. Composes Card + Icon primitives.

ai.whenToUse: Use mid-page to enumerate 3–6 product capabilities, benefits, or value props. Each feature is a card with an icon, short title, and one- or two-sentence description. Best for SaaS, agency service lists, gym class types — anywhere a tidy comparison helps.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for image-heavy showcases (use a different layout). Don't use with more than 6 features — visual weight collapses; pick the top 3 and link out to details.

subheadline.example: Every feature ties back to one thing: getting code into production faster, with fewer surprises.

features.description: Feature cards. Each must declare `title`, `description`, and an `icon` from the Icon primitive's set.

example.title: Atomic preview deploys
example.description: Every PR gets a unique URL with a real environment. Reviewers click, not clone.
